title: Image of God
definition: The image of God means that human beings were created to reflect God’s character, represent His rule under Him, live in relationship with Him, and bear unique dignity among creation.
summary: Though sin has marred humanity, it has not erased human dignity. The image of God grounds the value of every person and the call to live under God’s authority.
christFocus: Christ is the perfect image of God. Through Him, believers are being renewed into true righteousness, holiness, and conformity to His likeness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The image gives every person God-given dignity.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Sin distorts but does not destroy human worth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Renewal in Christ restores believers toward the image they were created to bear.
